id./param/scenario/cs/a_110_cs_090.pack|cs_: "As I thought... I didn't believe you would die from something like that. Darkspawn...
"...Sixteen years since that cursed day. To find you alive, Princess, is a joy beyond hope for Hendrik...
"But why do you shield the Darkspawn? Even you, Princess, I must cut down if you obstruct my lord's command.
"General Hendrik, I understand your position. But we have things we must do too.
"...Princess. My only lord is King Carnelian. My lord's orders come before all else.
"I see... You haven't changed, Hendrik. I know how strong your loyalty is. Talking won't reach you...
"I'm impressed. Quite skilled. Sixteen years ago you were a mere tomboy princess, but you've clearly weathered many battles.
"Don't be ridiculous!! Praising your opponent in the middle of a fight, are you trying to show off?!
"You underestimate me, Princess! Fighting while shielding the Darkspawn is absurd! Can you block my sword so?!
"Be careful not to be thrown off!
